decision_summary: Approve the v0.4.2 Quality Aspect taxonomy implementation.
rationale: The implementation adds broad aspect coverage, links it to evaluation perspectives, and retains verifier guardrails against checklist misuse.
recommendation: Keep v0.4.2 as the aspect taxonomy slice and leave complete core fixture coverage as the next roadmap item.
expected_user_reaction: Use Quality Aspects to discover concerns without treating aspect coverage as a verdict.
artifact_change_recommendations: Do not add semantic completeness claims to verifier output.
organization_change_recommendations: Run latest QIF tests and AOF checks before any release.
